title: CUMPRINC sums PPMT left to right, and CUMIPMT is count*PMT less CUMPRINC
statement: On the 30-year loan, CUMPRINC(0.05/12,360,200000,1,12,0) equals the left-to-right binary64 sum of Excel's own twelve PPMT answers, to the last bit, and CUMIPMT over the same periods equals 12*PMT - CUMPRINC, computed from Excel's own answers, to the last bit.
basis: One loan block of the catalogue capture, recomputed from the recorded answers by binary64 arithmetic.
inferred: That this shape holds for every loan is inferred from this block; PPMT and PMT themselves are not yet reproduced, so a wider check is not available.
